description: This Java class 'EdgeBulkImportService' extends 'AbstractBulkImportService' to handle bulk import operations for 'Edge' entities in the Thingsboard platform. It manages setting entity fields, saving entities with associated rule chains, and assigning ownership details.

classes.name: EdgeBulkImportService
classes.description: Service class for bulk importing Edge entities, extending abstract bulk import functionalities.

methods.name: setEntityFields
methods.description: Sets various fields of the Edge entity based on provided CSV import fields.

methods.name: saveEntity
methods.description: Saves the Edge entity using TbEdgeService, associating it with a rule chain.

methods.name: findOrCreateEntity
methods.description: Finds an existing Edge by tenant ID and name or creates a new one.

methods.name: setOwners
methods.description: Assigns tenant and customer ownership to the Edge entity.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the EntityType for this service, which is EDGE.
